cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID; 16,463 recognised refugees lacked valid ID cards in August 2026.
cells.note: Stage 3: UNHCR says 2,337 asylum-seekers in the north were issued protection documents by June 2026, of about 30,400 refugees and asylum-seekers registered. Enrolment in the national register is still being set up and nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
